svg.text: W FILLS THE CALLER. COLUMNS AUTO-SIZE.
WT MAY EXCEED W; HORIZONTAL SCROLL IS BUILT IN.
SM / MD ARE MINIMUM ROW HEIGHTS.
WRAPPING OR TALL CONTENT GROWS EACH ROW.
SELECTION BAR OVERLAYS THE EXISTING HEADER.
LABELS FADE; COLUMN WIDTHS DO NOT REFLOW.
SELECT GUTTER ALWAYS PINS TO INLINE START.
ACTIONS PIN IF THE LAST DATA COLUMN PINS END.
OUTLINE, VERTICAL RULES AND CAPTION OPTIONAL.
HORIZONTAL RULES AND STICKY HEADER DEFAULT ON.
TOOLBAR / PAGINATION WRAP; WIDTHS ARE HUG.

g.text: HEIGHTS 1:1 · WIDTHS SCHEMATIC · SM · FIVE ROW SLOTS
W · VIEWPORT FILL / WT · TABLE AUTO
NO FIXED TABLE / COLUMN WIDTH. H4 ASSUMES UNWRAPPED ROWS.
TOOLBAR + S3 + TABLE / CAPTION + S3 + PAGINATION = CONTENT HEIGHT.

svg.text: PROPORTIONAL · SEPARATION NOT A CSS ELEVATION
NO SCRIM OR DROP SHADOW ON THE TABLE.
STICKY CELL PAINT IS OPAQUE; CONTENT SCROLLS BELOW.
PINNED HEADER SEAM: 1 PX UPWARD FILL SHADOW.

g.text: SCALE 2:1 · SM / MD · HEIGHTS ARE MINIMA
HORIZONTAL RULE B IS ABSENT ON LAST BODY ROW.

svg.text: GAP S9 BETWEEN COUNT AND ACTIONS.
HEADER PINS AT TOP 0; SCROLLBAR INSET = HEADER.
SKELETONS: H8 HIGH · W3 CYCLES BY COLUMN.
EMPTY ROW: H5 MIN; CONTENT MAY GROW.
